title: Feta-Brined Chicken Bowls with Shirazi Salad
description: Tender feta-brined chicken breast over basmati rice with a bright, chopped Persian cucumber and tomato salad.
ingredients: 100 g feta brine (from a feta tub)
steps: Brine the chicken in the feta liquid for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Toss the cucumber, tomato, onion, lemon juice and herbs into a Shirazi salad, and serve over rice with the chicken.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste feta-brined chicken bowls

notes: The feta brine tenderizes the chicken through its salt content — do not skip the hour of brining time.
